name: Feature Flags & Progressive Rollout
description: Feature Flags & Progressive Rollout standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-FLAG applies.

rules.title: Every feature flag has an owner, purpose and removal condition
rules.detail: Flags must record owner, default, target audience, rollout plan and expiry/removal criteria.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Every feature flag has an owner, purpose and removal condition.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Every feature flag has an owner, purpose and removal condition.

rules.title: Choose safe defaults for unavailable flag services
rules.detail: Define whether each flag fails open or closed; security and authorization controls must not depend on a client-side feature flag.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Choose safe defaults for unavailable flag services.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Choose safe defaults for unavailable flag services.

rules.title: Support progressive rollout and rapid rollback
rules.detail: Use percentage/cohort targeting where useful and keep the previous behavior deployable until rollout confidence is established.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Support progressive rollout and rapid rollback.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Support progressive rollout and rapid rollback.

rules.title: Test both enabled and disabled paths while both are supported
rules.detail: Automated or explicit manual coverage must include important flag states and interaction with migrations/configuration.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test both enabled and disabled paths while both are supported.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test both enabled and disabled paths while both are supported.

rules.title: Do not use long-lived flags as permanent configuration
rules.detail: Retire rollout/experiment flags after completion; persistent business configuration belongs in a governed configuration model.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not use long-lived flags as permanent configuration.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not use long-lived flags as permanent configuration.

rules.title: Protect sensitive targeting attributes
rules.detail: Do not expose confidential segmentation logic or unnecessary personal attributes to clients.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Protect sensitive targeting attributes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Protect sensitive targeting attributes.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-FLAG applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Feature Flags & Progressive Rollout to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Feature Flags & Progressive Rollout is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Feature Flags & Progressive Rollout failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
